verdict.summary: The change is fail-closed and the two-part inertness proof is sound for its stated scope: unchanged verbatim non-comment lines prevent YAML source rewrites, while parsed-document equality rejects edits to comment-looking text inside block scalars. Missing dependencies, unreadable blobs, merge-base failures, parse failures, and declined proofs all retain the prior full-run behavior. The selection wiring preserves other full-run triggers and crate changes, and the tests exercise both load-bearing halves plus fallback behavior without appearing vacuous.
